summary: Replace oversized native Android tool cards with compact, informative, accessible activity rows.

desktop.reason: Desktop already renders compact tool-specific label/detail rows in src/renderer/components/chat/ToolCallBlock.tsx; this Android density fix does not change desktop behavior.

reactNativeIos.reason: React Native/iOS already renders a quiet one-line ToolItem with a humanized summary, tool icon, running spinner, and output-only disclosure in apps/mobile/src/screens/ThreadScreen.tsx.

sharedBackendApi.reason: The existing tool.started, tool.completed, and turn.completed event contract and reducer identity policy are preserved without wire-format changes.

storageDataMigration.reason: Tool input and output already persist in historical thread snapshots, while expansion remains transient UI state keyed by the existing stable row identity.

updateRelease.reason: The UI-only fix changes no package identity, version, signing configuration, schema, deep link, or update channel; it is recorded for the next native Android app release and the debug APK is assembled during verification.

automated: ThreadPresentationTest and ToolActivityLayoutPolicyTest pass, covering normalized labels/details/icons/state, malformed inputs, 140-character bounds, stable keys, and the 48 dp density policy.
ThreadScreenRegressionTest compiles with compact-row regression coverage for disclosure, semantics, ordering, recomposition, large fonts, and ten-tool density.
Native Android testDebugUnitTest, lintDebug, assembleDebug, and compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin pass.
Repository TypeScript typecheck and the complete split-runtime repository test gate pass.
notExercised: No Android device or emulator was connected, so connectedDebugAndroidTest and device screenshots were not run.
Live Claude, Codex, and OpenCode turns, reconnect/history reload, TalkBack, Switch Access, D-pad/keyboard focus, device font scaling, and portrait/landscape checks were not exercised on hardware.
